reading: GRÜN · §82 — A-G49's hooks checked by SET EQUALITY against the two routes that predate them
scope: rendered-page DOM and computed style on a loopback build. No raster, no luminance, no sealed datum touched.
standard: PINK's, adopted by GELB for the whole hook set: set equality against class membership and animationName, on the rendered page. This probe never asks whether an attribute exists; it asks whether the partition it induces is the same SET as two older independent routes induce.
motion: LIVE — route 3 needs the animation running to be a route

route2_classMembership.selector: .mf-halo > circle:not(.mf-wave-halo) | .mf-wave-halo — PINK's §15 selector, predating the hook

crossChecks.note: rank|shelf|required-gaps as a MULTISET, so halo and body are matched by identity rather than by concentricity under 2 px — which is the inference the hook exists to replace

oneHueCarrier.note: the halos with data-required-gaps > 0 must be exactly the halos filled url(#mf-halo-gap). PG-12's carrier previously had to infer this from proximity.

seats.groupFlagNote: arc-marks carries data-seat-is-group because selecting it does not select a painted mark — the A-G31 shape stated where it still applies

finding: ALL 7 CHECKS AGREE. The hook's shelf/field partition is set-identical to PINK's class-membership partition AND to the browser's own animationName partition (3 shelf, 2 field); the halo identity multiset equals the body identity multiset, so halo-to-body matching no longer needs geometric inference; the one hue's carrier read from the attribute equals the carrier read from the fill; and data-halo-radius equals the rendered r. Seats MISSING at this level: open-body-ring — expected where a level does not draw them, and listed rather than passed over.
